owner: Government of Burkina Faso / MTDPCE / ANPTIC
notes: Two government modular data centers in Ouagadougou (Centre/Kadiogo), inaugurated 2026-01-23 under the data-sovereignty program; ANPTIC board session confirms the January 2026 inauguration. Combined reported capacity ~3 PB storage, 105.6 TB RAM, 28,800 CPU cores, 7,000+ VMs; ~15.2-16 bn FCFA; 5-10 days energy autonomy. Exact physical addresses not public; two sites represented as one project pending address confirmation.
